concept: API Gateway + Lambda: serverless REST API with auto scaling
tests: Choosing a front-door service for a REST API that scales for bursts on its own with no server management.
expected: Amazon API Gateway + Lambda: fully managed, scales automatically, no servers. Triggers: "REST API", "automatically scale to handle bursts", "free of server management".
why_not: A single EC2 isn't HA and doesn't scale; an on-prem LB isn't elastic; EC2 Auto Scaling still means managing instances.
